messages.author: cf8410be4af0ebfe
messages.subject: Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, stat = stat,  :    could not find fun
parts:
Using ggplot2 version 0.9.3.1, I got:

> pdf("hagelloch.gof.pdf")
> library(ggplot2)
> library(grid)
> library(scales)
> ggplot(allsims, aes(day, i,group = sim)) + geom_line(alpha = I(20/samplesize), size = 2) + scale_y_continuous("number of infectives")+ scale_x_continuous("day") + geom_boxplot(subset = .( day %% 5 == 0),aes(group = day),width = 2,outlier.size = .7,alpha = .5)+ geom_line(subset = .(isreal == 1),colour = "red", size = 1)
Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, stat = stat,  :
  could not find function "."
Calls: geom_boxplot -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous> -> do.call
Execution halted

The code used to work before, i.e., in 2011/2.
Any ideas?
